description: Ozero Mail: one calm inbox for all your email on Android and iOS. No AI reading your mail, no subscription.
h1: All your email. One calm inbox.
sub: A mail app for Android and iOS. No AI reading your mail, no subscription.

pains.a: Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and work mail in one list. Each account keeps its own color.
Nobody. There’s no AI, and my servers never see your mail: it goes from your provider straight to your phone.

pains.q: Real letters lost in the noise?
pains.a: People come first. Newsletters and notifications wait in their own tabs.

soon: Ozero Mail is still in the works. Write to me, and I’ll answer on launch day.
mailSubj: Tell me when Ozero Mail is out
mailBody: Hi! Write me once, on launch day.
shotLabel: The app’s inbox: letters from four accounts, each marked with its color
tip: Swipe a letter left or press Done.
calm: All clear. That’s how the app should feel.
